corrected_classification: normal terminal-release state observation under a held Q-up callback; no evidence of public cancellation or cancellation recovery.
reason: raw.json has no public_cancel field; run/calls has no cancel artifact; producer-result.json reports result.status=completed and verified terminal release_all.
root_cause_from_frozen_source: probe.py reads local hold_ms when computing the pre-cancel callback budget before assigning hold_ms later in the same function (the assignment occurs after interface_cancel). Python therefore raises UnboundLocalError before the public cancel call; the outer MCP TaskGroup reports only ExceptionGroup. This is confirmed by source ordering and explains the absent public_cancel record.
